method.tsne: sklearn TSNE barnes_hut, perplexity=30, max_iter=1000, init=pca, random_state=42
method.kmeans: sklearn KMeans k=8 (STATED, not eyeballed), n_init=10, random_state=42, fit on 64-d embeddings

meta.coord_encoding: V4: int millis of the centered, unit-max-radius-normalized projection (3 decimals of the rendered value); divide by 1000. Rendered positions match V3 up to <=0.00087 Euclidean per point.
meta.id: omitted per-point; point id IS its index in the points array

fields.n: delta-encoded indices into meta.names (prefix-sum to decode)
fields.m: packed per-point int: season=1996+(m>>9), team=meta.teams[((m>>3)&63)-1] (-1 => null), cluster=m&7
fields.pca/tsne/umap: flat int arrays, 3 per point in row order; int millis of centered unit-normalized coords, /1000; loader must not re-center/re-normalize
